## Goal
Write a developer page that follows one exposure scan from profile to result: variants, tier check, search, rate limit and back-off, matching, scoring, coverage. Every claim cites file:line on current main.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Each stage has a short section with at least one `path:line` citation that resolves.
2. A diagram in plain text lists the order of calls.
3. A section 'Where to add a new broker search adapter' with exact files.
4. Doc is under 400 lines; no personal data; fake names only.

Docs/tests-only work in Codex's lane. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL), offline, Windows-safe paths. Check `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `docs/dev/EXPOSURE_PIPELINE.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Every file not listed above. In particular: front end and design (`src/freemyid/wizard/`, `src/freemyid/templates/`, `web/`, `brand/`), in-house modules (`models.py`, `interfaces.py`, `state.py`, `registry.py`, `cli.py`, `config.py`, `paths.py`, `netpolicy.py`, `consent.py`, `logging_setup.py`, `crypto.py`, `secrets.py`, `storage/`, `schema/`, `engine/browser.py`), Grok's modules (`engine/mail*`, `engine/outbox.py`, `engine/runner.py`, `engine/tiers.py`, `engine/handoff.py`, `engine/plugins.py`, `engine/filler.py`, `engine/fill_for_me.py`, `submitters/`, `scheduler/`, `notify.py`, `setup_config.py`, `cli_json.py`), `brokers/` data and existing tests not listed.
